name: Brave Leo
desc: Privacy-first AI assistant built into the Brave browser.
desc_zh: 内置于 Brave 浏览器的注重隐私的 AI 助手。
solves: Every assistant you paste a question into learns something from it. Leo answers without logging your prompts or training on them.
solves_zh: 你把问题贴进哪个助手，哪个都在从中学东西。Leo 作答时不记录你的 prompt，也不拿它训练。
best_for: When you want to ask something from the address bar without handing over your search history.
best_for_zh: 当你想在地址栏直接提问，又不想交出搜索历史。
notes: The reference point for 'AI that doesn't watch you' — no login, no chat logging, no training on your prompts. 来源：https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/news/1236871
